prior_work: Goddard-Kent-Olive coset construction is established prior work. Original 1985 article metadata was identified but its full proof was not newly retrieved. Langmann-Semenoff hep-th/9404159 remained a lead; attempted HTML retrieval failed. MMP rotational screening remains part of the prior retained source review.
search_outcome: No exact predecessor to the displayed midpoint current-vertex tail coefficient was established by these bounded searches. This is not a priority or novelty finding. Broader physical novelty review remains open.
proof_review_limits: No full current-sector mass-gap proof, compact/global branching classification for the wormhole, interacting finite-return stress, physical state or smooth junction. Linear matrix-space leakage is not a projection onto coset excitations.
development_notes: Initial isolated CAR/projection/continuum output was recovered by rerunning after continuation lost the process handle. It passed. Final checks were then expanded to both ladder and Cartesian currents and delay increments; the complete receipt passed with no failed scientific case observed.
contribution_decision: Continue physical long-return damping as primary and matched finite-duration band transfer as fallback. The established local current coset has c=q-4+6/(k+2), k=q(q^2-1)/6. Unequal point-dipole returns do not preserve the linear electric/rotational current space: longitudinal two-frequency squared leakage is 3 pi kappa |omega2-omega1| delta+o(delta), while transverse leakage is o(delta). Equal-frequency conjugation and central-charge replacement do not close the physical quantum state or stress. No interacting damping, global coset factorization, smooth junction or consequential novelty is accepted.
next_decisive_question: Derive the coupled finite-time electric/rotational state and gauged exterior response with the two-frequency current vertices, moving load, quadratic vertex and exterior determinant retained; control renormalized stress, omitted modes and smooth semiclassical matching.
